queue.title: Setup, inputs, masks
queue.notes: Identified 4 pairs. Built masks for bars, captions, 6px invalid border, line edges, and flat interior for pairs A, B, C, D with overlay previews.

queue.title: Alignment audit
queue.notes: Sub-pixel ECC and SIFT affine alignment complete for all 4 pairs. Edge corr reached 0.9254 (Pair A), 0.8690 (Pair B), 0.8627 (Pair C), and 0.5101 (Pair D). Aligned originals saved to analysis/outputs/aligned/.

queue.title: Colour correction fit
queue.notes: M2_sRGB (per-channel Levels + 3x3 Colour Matrix in display space) selected. Average median DE00 is 5.860 vs 8.997 for linear. Pair B median DE00 is 1.7257 (within noise floor). Exported 33x33x33 look.cube.

queue.title: Gradient / lower-area darkening
queue.notes: 2D surface discovery found vertical spatial gradient explains < 0.2% variance and radial vignette explains < 0.8%. Darkening gradient is absent as a static look component for GOJO; scene luma variations are scene-dependent.
